scope: Starter-only repeatability controls for official Intel SYCL/Level Zero; no all-model or performance-win qualification
limitations: These are numerical-repeatability diagnostics on one model, not a repeated seven-model performance baseline.
Earlier attempts and their failures remain frozen; a later passing sample does not prove an underlying nondeterminism was fixed.
Disabling oneDNN attention is separate from disabling all oneDNN operations. Each treatment retains both settings.
A native configuration still needs frozen-oracle continuations and full repeated-output qualification on every catalog model.
